== Summary ==
The organizer's "Winner Photo" from the [[2015 Rosemount Jedi/Padawan Tournament]] (3 January 2015): the winning pair holding their glass trophies. The final standings in the same post list Sean and Taylor first; the post does not say which is which.

* '''Event:''' [[2015 Rosemount Jedi/Padawan Tournament]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2015-01-04

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=925441#p925441 post 925441] in topic 56802 (First Annual Jedi / Padawan Tournament-Burnsville, MN), by Walsetmd, 2015-01-04. Forum attachment id 4127 (Winner Photo.jpg). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123225259/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p925441.html Internet Archive]
* '''Posted by:''' Walsetmd
* '''Processing:''' Saved upright: the attachment carried a wrong EXIF rotation flag, which was dropped.
